Pete Hegseth Faces Criticism Over Pentagon Role and Remarks

Pete Hegseth, a prominent figure involved with the Pentagon, is facing criticism from various outlets. Some reports highlight accusations of 'body shaming' directed at a cadet youth instructor, which has led to bipartisan backlash. Concurrently, other coverage focuses on Hegseth's influence over the Pentagon's future, describing it as a period of significant departures and internal division. One outlet suggests Hegseth is 'winning the battle' for the Pentagon's direction, while another frames his tenure as the institution 'lurching off the rails'.
